title: git.commit: read keyrack.yml org as a list, with a multi-org suite
description:
## .what

`get_org_from_keyrack` (dist/domain.roles/mechanic/skills/git.commit/git.commit.operations.sh, 1.43.0) reads `.agent/keyrack.yml` `org:` as one scalar line. a yaml list under `org:` reads empty, so every `git.commit.set` refuses with `.agent/keyrack.yml#org required` and names `git.commit.uses allow --org <org>`, a remedy that cannot help.

```yaml
org:
  - ehmpathy
  - nheuron
```

keyrack itself accepts this form (a repo whose keys span two org slots), so the commit gate and keyrack disagree on one file.

## .ask

1. read `org:` as a scalar OR a list (block form and flow form `[a, b]`)
2. decide and declare the multi-org gate rule. candidates: the first item is the gate org (matches the scalar behavior today), or every listed org must allow. name which, in the skill help
3. a refusal on an unreadable `org:` names the shape it read, not a grant to run
4. a multi-org suite: scalar, block list, flow list, empty list, `org:` absent, list where one org is blocked; each asserts the gate org and the exit code

## .second defect, found on the way

the published package files carry mode 0555 (`-r-xr-xr-x`). `pnpm patch-commit` then fails with `ERR_PNPM_PATCH_FAILED Could not apply patch`, because the applier writes in place into a read-only file. so a consumer cannot hold a local pnpm patch of any file in this package while it waits on a fix. ship files as 0644 / 0755.

## .context

rhachet-roles-nheuron PR #4 (head b0b2766). the commit landed only after its working-tree keyrack.yml held `org: ehmpathy` for the one call; the committed file keeps the list.
